hero.title: Your comfort, installed to the highest standard
hero.subtitle: Starios sells, installs and maintains air conditioning systems in Casablanca and across Morocco. Free quote, guaranteed equipment, and trained teams for the brands we install.

services.title: One point of contact, from advice to maintenance
services.subtitle: From equipment selection to annual maintenance, our teams cover the full lifecycle of your installation.

why.title: What changes when the installation is done properly
why.subtitle: A poorly sized air conditioner consumes more, breaks down sooner and cools poorly. Our work starts with calculation, not sales.
why.item1Body: We calculate the required power based on the surface area, exposure and use of the space — not by guesswork.
why.item2Body: Only new units from official networks, with manufacturer warranty and invoice.
why.item3Body: Vacuuming, leak checks, compliant fixings: the steps others skip.
why.item4Body: Optional maintenance contract and priority repair service for our clients.
why.proofTitle: Installations designed to last and to reassure.
why.proofBody: We focus on durable comfort, precise installation and customer follow-up so every project brings real everyday well-being.
why.highlight1Body: Clear analysis of your needs before any recommendation.
why.highlight2Body: Full checks before handing over your installation.
why.highlight3Body: Responsiveness, follow-up and advice after installation.
why.reviewText: Trust, installation quality and close support.
why.processTitle: A clear experience, from study to commissioning
why.processSubtitle: Every project follows a simple, transparent method designed for your home or workplace.
why.process1Body: We analyse your space, your usage and constraints to choose the best solution.
why.process2Body: You receive a clear quote tailored to your budget, without ambiguity or hidden extra costs.
why.process3Body: Our technicians carry out the installation, verify the proper operation and stay with you after commissioning.

extra.title: A complete offer for lasting comfort
extra.subtitle: Beyond installation, we support you in choosing the right system, optimizing consumption and keeping your equipment performing over the long term.
extra.benefit1Body: We help you choose the solution that best fits your space, your use and your budget.
extra.benefit2Body: Regular follow-up helps preserve efficiency, reduce breakdowns and extend the life of your installation.
extra.benefit3Body: We respond quickly for urgent needs, repairs and project handovers.
extra.benefit4Body: We work across several cities in Morocco for both private and professional customers.
extra.coverageSubtitle: Local coverage for reliable and fast service.
extra.coverageText: We cover the most requested cities and zones to deliver a service that is reliable, quick and tailored to each configuration.
extra.faq1A: Depending on your area and request, we aim to respond quickly, with first contact within 24 business hours.
extra.faq2Q: Can we replace an existing system?
extra.faq2A: Yes. We assess your current installation to propose a more efficient, economical and comfortable solution.
extra.faq3Q: Do you offer a diagnosis before quotation?
extra.faq3A: Yes. We help define the right criteria before any recommendation so your choice is secure.

cta.title: Need an air-conditioning project? Let’s talk.
cta.subtitle: Describe your need in three steps. You receive an immediate estimate, then a firm quote after a technical visit.
cta.reassurance: Free and without obligation · Reply within business days

about.title: Sustainable comfort for your space
about.subtitle: Installation, maintenance and advice for efficient and responsible air conditioning.
about.intro: We help homes and businesses breathe better while reducing their energy consumption. Since 2008, our team has offered tailor-made solutions that respect the environment and last over time.
about.whyTitle: Expertise at the service of comfort and performance
about.whySubtitle: We combine a real understanding of indoor comfort with a practical, clear and sustainable approach.

values.title: Sustainable solutions
values.text: We design installations that reduce energy consumption without compromising comfort.

values.title: Quality and reliability
values.text: Each project benefits from rigorous support, reliable equipment and trustworthy service.

values.title: Proactive maintenance
values.text: We ensure ongoing support to preserve performance and the longevity of your system.

about.diffTitle: Straightforward choices, grounded in real comfort and long-term performance.
about.diffSubtitle: We place transparency, installation quality and genuine comfort at the center of every project.

differentiators.title: Honest diagnosis
differentiators.text: We assess your needs without overselling or recommending unnecessary solutions, so every installation fits your real usage.

differentiators.title: Careful installation
differentiators.text: Each project is designed to be clean, quiet, durable and respectful of your living space.

differentiators.title: Long-term support
differentiators.text: We stay by your side after installation to optimise performance, prevent issues and keep your comfort secure.

about.adnTitle: A clear, human and results-oriented approach.
about.adnBody: We believe comfort comes from simple, efficient installations designed to last. That is why we work with transparency, listening and precision at every stage.
adnPoints: Listening to real needs and honest recommendations
Choosing solutions adapted to budget and usage
Quality follow-up and reassuring after-sales service
process: Clear, transparent quote adapted to your needs
Installation carried out by qualified technicians
about.finalTitle: A solution designed for your space, your comfort and your budget.
about.finalBody: We listen to your needs to propose a reliable, efficient and durable installation.
